svg.title: Digital wireframe: Forecast Fits About screen, laptop
svg.desc: Landscape About screen with a large introduction column and readable sections for creator, weather source, recommendation method, privacy, and artwork credits.
svg.text: A quick campus outfit idea and a few
forecast. This is a planning aid.
Open-Meteo Forecast + Geocoding APIs · link and CC BY 4.0 attribution
Free tier is non-commercial; commercial promotion requires another plan.
Daily high chooses one of five clothing layers. Rain and snow gear modify it;
UV, hydration, cold, and storm reminders come from coded weather rules.
Thresholds are project heuristics, not medical or official clothing advice.
Open-Meteo · CDC heat guidance · WHO UV Index · National Weather Service
The hourly tip is a forecast-based rain window, not a safety guarantee.
No account, tracking, or location history. Only the latest place is kept on-device.
Device location is only requested when selected; coordinates go to Open-Meteo.
Original SVG character and clothing illustrations by Jack Lepien.
Development assistance: Claude Code. No third-party artwork in the app.
